y-m-64-06.title: Probability inochinja sei sezvo ruzivo ruchiwedzerwa rumwe panguva?
y-m-64-06.topic: Conditional probability: probability inochinja sei sezvo ruzivo ruchiwedzerwa
y-m-64-06.goal: Tevera, nekuverenga nyaya, kuti nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rutsva painosvika, nyaya dzinogoneka dzinodzikira uye probability inokwira, inoramba yakadaro, kana kuva 1.
y-m-64-06.material: Dice tsvuku nedice yebhuruu zvinotarwa kamwe chete imwe neimwe. Madice maviri akatendeseka uye haakanganisani, uye chiso chimwe nechimwe kubva ku1 kusvika ku6 chinobuda neprobability yakaenzana. Kana sum yezviso zviviri iri 8 kana kupfuura, inonzi 'kubudirira'. Mhedzisiro haisati yazikanwa, uye ruzivo runopiwa rumwe panguva.
y-m-64-06.thinking.0: Ona kuti ruzivo rutsva runochinja sei nyaya dzinogoneka
y-m-64-06.thinking.1: Taura hwaro hwekuchinja kana kuchengeta kutonga
y-m-64-06.prereq.0: 'H1' mubasa iri inongova chiratidzo chenhanho yekuoma neyerubatsiro mukugoverwa kwekugadzira uku uye haireve kuti curriculum inogovera chidzidzo ichi kugore rechikoro rakati. Inofungidzira kuti wakasangana, mu high school Probability and Statistics, nenzira yekutsvaga probability se (huwandu hwenyaya dzinoitika) ÷ (huwandu hwenyaya dzose).
y-m-64-06.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwekunyora zviso zvema dice maviri semapeya akarongwa 36 (chiso che dice tsvuku, chiso che dice yebhuruu)
y-m-64-06.prereq.2: Pfungwa ye 'kuchengeta nyaya dzinokodzera ruzivo rwakapiwa chete'
y-m-64-06.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa rumwe panguva. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza kuti probability ye 'kubudirira' yakakura zvakadii.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.hint.0: Nguva imwe neimwe kana wagamuchira ruzivo, nyora nyaya 36 mutafura, bvisa maseru asingakodzeri ruzivo, uye uverenge maseru asara.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga huwandu hwemaseru asara ane sum 8 kana kupfuura, nyora ratio, uye uienzanise padivi neratio yedanho rakapfuura.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.info: Iri ndiro risati rarasa. Hapana ruzivo nezve zviso parizvino.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.ask: Probability yekubudirira (sum yezviso zviviri iri 8 kana kupfuura) inenge yakakura zvakadii?
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.after: Nyaya dzine sum 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 dzinova nenzira 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 zvichiteerana, saka 15 dzose. Probability ndi 15/36 = 5/12.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kana ukanyora nyaya dzose dzine sum 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, hadzisi nzira 12. Tarisa kuti nzira mbiri dzakasiiwa pa sum ipi.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uku kufanofungidzira kwakatora kukosha kwepakati kwema sums, 7, semuganhu uye kwakaona sehafu nehafu. Nzira 6 dzine sum 7 hadzisi kubudirira.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Izvi zvinosangana nekukosha kubva pakuverenga nyaya dzine sum 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 nekudzivedzera.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Izvi zvingava kufanofungidzira kwakanzwa kuti '8 kana kupfuura' irenji rakafara pakati pema sums 6 (7 kusvika ku12). Sum ichikura, nyaya dzinova dzishoma.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.info: Mudzidzi anokuudza chete kuti 'sum yezviso zviviri iri even'. Hauchiziva zviso.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.after: Nyaya dzine sum even ndi18 nzira (sums 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 dzine nzira 1, 3, 5, 5, 3, 1 zvichiteerana), uye pakati pazvo kubudirira (sums 8, 10, 12) ndi9 nzira. Probability ndi 9/18 = 1/2, yakava hombe kupfuura 5/12.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Izvi zvinosangana nekukosha kubva pakuverenga, pakati penzira 18 dzine sum even, nzira 5 + 3 + 1 = 9 dzine sum 8, 10, 12.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ruzivo rwekuti sum iri even runodzikisa nyaya dzinogoneka kubva panzira 36 kusvika ku18. Unofanira kuverenga zvakare mukati menyaya dzakadzikiswa.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Yakava diki, kusvika kuchikamu chimwe chete chetatu
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kana ukachengeta nyaya dzine sum even chete, chikamu chenyaya dzine sum 8, 10, 12 chinova chikuru chaizvo. Verenga iwe pachako nyaya dzinosara.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Yakava hombe zvikuru, kusvika kuanenge 5/6 kana kupfuura
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Nyaya dzine sum even dzinosanganisira sums 2, 4, 6 zvakare. Nyaya dzakawanda dzisiri kubudirira dzichiri dzakasara.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.info: Mudzidzi anowedzera: 'Sum iri even, uye zviso zvema dice maviri zvakasiyana kubva kune mumwe.'
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.after: Nyaya dzine sum even nezviso zvakasiyana ndi18 - 6 = 12 nzira, uye pakati pazvo kubudirira ndi9 - 3 = 6 nzira. Probability ndi 6/12 = 1/2, ichiramba yakadaro. Nyaya 3 dzekubudirira (4,4), (5,5), (6,6) dzakabviswa pamwe chete, saka ratio haina kuchinja.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kana ukabvisa nyaya apo zviso zvakafanana, nyaya dzekubudirira dzinobviswawo. Verenga kuti zvinobviswa zvakadii kudivi rimwe nerimwe.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Tarisa kana wakafungidzira kuti nyaya dzine zviso zvakafanana dziri padivi risiri rekubudirira chete. Ma sums e (4,4), (5,5), (6,6) ndeapi?
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ruzivo rutsva rwawedzerwa, saka inofanira kuchinja
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ruzivo rutsva hahugari huchichinja probability. Verenga nyaya dzinosara uye utarise ratio iwe pachako.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Uku kutonga kwakaverenga kuti kunyange kana nyaya dzine zviso zvakafanana dzabviswa, nyaya dzekubudirira dzinobviswawo neratio imwe chete.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.info: Uyu ndiwo ruzivo rwekupedzisira. Unoudzwa kuti chiso che dice tsvuku ndi6. (Sum iri even, uye zviso zviviri zvakasiyana.)
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.after: Kana chiso tsvuku chiri 6 uye sum iri even, chiso chebhuruu chiri chimwe che2, 4, 6, uye sezvo zviso zviviri zvakasiyana, 6 inobviswa, ichisiya 2 kana 4. Sum ndi8 kana 10, zvose 8 kana kupfuura, saka probability ndi1.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Kana chiso che dice tsvuku chatarwa, zviso zvinogoneka zve dice yebhuruu zvinodzikira zvikuru. Nyora iwe pachako nyaya dzinosara.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakasimbisa kuti nyaya dzinosara ndezviso zvebhuruu 2 ne4 chete, ane sums 8 ne10, zvose kubudirira.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Unogona kutarisa nekunyora iwe pachako kana pane nyaya dzisiri kubudirira dzinosara.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.r.d: Verenga imwe neimwe sums dzenyaya apo chiso tsvuku chiri 6, sum iri even, uye chiso chebhuruu chisiri 6.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.reflect: Probability yakachinja se 5/12 → 1/2 → 1/2 → 1. Ndeapi ruzivo rwakachinja probability, uye ndeapi risina? Taura kuti chii chinoitika kana ruzivo rwodzikisa nyaya dzinogoneka uye nyaya dzekubudirira nedzisiri kubudirira dzichidzikira neratio imwe chete.
y-m-64-06.s.s2.prompt: Padanho 3, ruzivo rwe 'zviso zviviri zvakasiyana' rwakawedzerwa asi probability haina kuchinja. Tsanangura kuti nei isina kuchinja, uchishandisa huwandu hwenyaya dzakasara.
y-m-64-06.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora nyaya 6 dzakabviswa padanho 3 mutafura uye uverenge kuti dzingani dzine sum ye8 kana kupfuura.
y-m-64-06.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora 'huwandu hwenyaya dzekubudirira ÷ huwandu hwenyaya dzose' pamberi nepashure pekubvisa uye uienzanise.
y-m-64-06.s.s2.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kunyange kana tikabvisa nyaya dzine zviso zvakafanana, ...
y-m-64-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakataura here huwandu hwenyaya dzekubudirira (4,4), (5,5), (6,6) pakati penyaya dzakabviswa (nyaya 6 dzine zviso zvakafanana)?
y-m-64-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakaisa mumashoko ako pachako here pfungwa yekuti 'ruzivo rutsva hahugari huchichinja probability'?
y-m-64-06.s.s2.model.0: Pakati penyaya 6 dzine zviso zvakafanana, dzine sum ye8 kana kupfuura ndidzo nyaya 3 (4,4), (5,5), (6,6), hafu chaiyo. Pakati penzira 18 dzine sum even, kubudirira kwaiva nzira 9, hafu, saka kunyange mushure mekubvisa nyaya 6 dzine zviso zvakafanana, kubudirira ndi6 pakati penzira 12 dzasara, uye ratio inoramba iri 1/2.
y-m-64-06.s.s2.model.1: Kunyange kana tikabvisa nyaya dzine chiso chakafanana, chikamu chine sum ye8 kana kupfuura pakati penyaya dzinosara chichiri hafu (6/12), saka probability haina kuchinja. Ruzivo rutsva rwakadzikisa nyaya dzinogoneka, asi rwakadzikisa nyaya dzekubudirira nedzisiri kubudirira neratio imwe chete.

y-m-64-09.title: Tinogona kutora huwandu hwekubudirira mumamiriro aya semadzokororo ane mukana wakafanana here?
y-m-64-09.topic: Binomial distribution: mamiriro apo model inoenderana nemamiriro apo isingaenderane
y-m-64-09.goal: Tonga, mamiriro nemamiriro, kuti mamiriro api anodiwa kuti utore huwandu hwekubudirira mumadzokororo sebinomial, uye usimbise nenhamba kuti mhedzisiro yekuverenga inochinja sei kana mamiriro iwayo akaputswa.
y-m-64-09.material: Kuti utore huwandu hwekubudirira sehunotevera binomial distribution, (1) huwandu hwemiedzo hunofanira kuva hwakasimbiswa, (2) muedzo wega wega unofanira kuva nemhedzisiro imwe pamaviri, kubudirira kana kukundikana, (3) mukana wekubudirira unofanira kuva wakafanana mumiedzo yese, uye (4) miedzo haifaniri kukanganisana. Tinoda kutarisa mamiriro mana aya mumamiriro ari pazasi. Bhokisi rine mabhora machena 6 nemabhora matema 4.
y-m-64-09.thinking.2: Batanidza musiyano wemitengo nechikonzero kana model i yakaipa
y-m-64-09.prereq.0: 'H1' mubasa iri i chiratidzo chedanho rekunetsa nerekutsigira chete mukugoverwa uku kwekugadzira uye hazvireve kuti curriculum inopa chidzidzo ichi kugore rechikoro riri rese. Inofungidzira kuti wakasangana, mu Probability ne Statistics yehigh school, ne independent trials nezvinoreva binomial distribution (huwandu hwekubudirira hunoverengwa nekudzokorora kubudirira kune mukana wakafanana ka n).
y-m-64-09.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwekuverenga huwandu hwenzira dzekusarudza dzimwe kubva pazvinhu zvakasiyana
y-m-64-09.prereq.2: Ruzivo rwekutsanangura mumashoko musiyano pakati pe sampling ne replacement ne isina replacement
y-m-64-09.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mamiriro ese ari pazasi apo 'huwandu hwekubudirira' hunogona kutorwa sebinomial.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.hint.0: Pasarudzo imwe neimwe, tarisa mamiriro mana rimwe nerimwe pasina kusiya. Kunyanya, tarisa kana mukana wekubudirira wakafanana mumiedzo yese.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.hint.1: Pasarudzo apo mukana unoratidzika kuchinja, nyora iwe pachako kuti mukana unochinja sei mushure memuedzo wekutanga kuti utarise.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.o.a: Huwandu hwemabhora machena anobuda kana ukabvisa mabhora rimwe panguva kubva mubhokisi, uchitarisa ruvara, usingaadzorere, uye ukabvisa ka 5
y-m-64-09.s.s1.r.a: Nguva imwe neimwe kana wabvisa rimwe, chikamu chemabhora machena mubhokisi chinochinja, saka mukana wekubudirira mumuedzo wega wega haugari wakafanana.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.o.b: Huwandu hwekubudirira kana mutambi ane mwero wekubudirira we 0.6 akakanda free throws 10 pasi pemamiriro akafanana, achifungidzira kuti mhedzisiro dzekare hadzikanganisi dzechitevera
y-m-64-09.s.s1.r.b: Iyi i sarudzo yakatarisa kuti mamiriro ese mana ari mumushoko.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.o.c: Huwandu hwekubudirira kana mutambi mumwechete akakanda ka 10, achitevera mutemo wekuti mwero wekubudirira unotevera i 0.8 kana kuedza kwekare kwakabudirira uye 0.4 kana kwakakundikana
y-m-64-09.s.s1.r.c: Mukana wekubudirira kwemuedzo unochinja zvichienderana nemhedzisiro yekare, saka miedzo inokanganisana.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.o.d: Huwandu hwemabhora machena anobuda kana ukadzokorora ka 5 kubvisa bhora rimwe kubva mubhokisi, kutarisa ruvara, nekuridzorera
y-m-64-09.s.s1.r.d: Iyi i sarudzo yakatarisa kuti, nekuti bhora rinodzorerwa, mamiriro ebhokisi akafanana nguva imwe neimwe.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.o.e: Huwandu hwemibvunzo yakapindurwa zvakarurama kana ukafungidzira zvisina kurongeka mibvunzo yese 10 ine sarudzo ina (mibvunzo haikanganisani)
y-m-64-09.s.s1.r.e: Iyi i sarudzo yakatarisa kuti mukana wekuwana mubvunzo mumwe nemumwe wakarurama wakafanana uye havakanganisani.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.explain: Mu b, d, ne e, huwandu hwemiedzo hwakasimbiswa, mukana wekubudirira mumuedzo wega wega wakagadzikana, uye miedzo haikanganisani. Mu a, mabhora abviswa haadzorerwi, saka mukana unochinja nemuedzo wega wega, uye mu c, mhedzisiro yekare inochinja mukana unotevera, saka miedzo inokanganisana.
y-m-64-09.s.s2.prompt: Mukana wekuti mutambi wesarudzo b (mwero wekubudirira 0.6) abudirire ka 7 chaizvo pa 10 i mukuru zvakadini?
y-m-64-09.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora chiitiko chimwe chine kubudirira 7 nekukundikana 3 uye uwane mukana wechiitiko ichocho.
y-m-64-09.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga kuti pane zviitiko zvakadaro zvingani zvese (ndedzipi 7 dzinobudirira), uye uwanze mukana wechiitiko chimwe nehuwandu uhwo.
y-m-64-09.s.s2.r.a: Uyu i mukana wechiitiko chimwe chete chakatarwa apo kubudirira 7 nekukundikana 3 zvinouya munhevedzano imwe chete. Wakasiya kuti pane nzvimbo dzakawanda dzinogoneka dze 7.
y-m-64-09.s.s2.r.b: Wakawanza mukana wekubudirira 7 chete uye hauna kuratidza mamiriro ekuti 3 dzakasara dzinokundikana.
y-m-64-09.s.s2.r.c: Wakanganisa chikamu chekubudirira (7/10) semukana. Chakasiyana nemukana wekuti mangani pa 10 anobudirira.
y-m-64-09.s.s2.r.d: Uyu i mutengo unoratidza zvose huwandu hwenzira dzekusarudza nzvimbo dze 7 nemukana wekubudirira 7 nekukundikana 3.
y-m-64-09.s.s2.explain: Huwandu hwenzira dzekusarudza nzvimbo dze 7 pa 10 i 10C7 = 120, uye mukana wechimwe nechimwe i 0.6^7 × 0.4^3 ≈ 0.001792, saka kuvawedzera kunopa 120 × 0.001792 ≈ 0.215.
y-m-64-09.s.s3.prompt: Kune sarudzo a (kubvisa 5 pasina kudzorera mabhora), mukana wekuti ese 5 i mabhora machena, wakaverengwa nefomula ye binomial, i 0.6 kune 5th power ≈ 0.078, asi kana wayerwa chaizvo i 6/252 ≈ 0.024. Tsanangura kuti sei mitengo miviri yakasiyana, uchibatanidza nemamiriro emamiriro aya.
y-m-64-09.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora huwandu hwemabhora machena nehuwandu hwese hwemabhora mubhokisi mushure mekunge bhora jena rabuda kutanga.
y-m-64-09.s.s3.hint.1: Wana mukana wekuti bhora jena ribude rechipiri uye uuenzanise ne 0.6.
y-m-64-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakapa nhamba chaidzo dzinoratidza mabhora machena mubhokisi achideredza nguva imwe neimwe rimwe rabviswa (semuenzaniso 6/10 wobva wa 5/9) here?
y-m-64-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura, kusanganisira nzira, kuti sei fomula ye binomial i hombe kupfuura mutengo chaiwo here?
y-m-64-09.s.s3.model.0: Nekuti mabhora abviswa haadzorerwi, chikamu chemabhora machena mubhokisi chinochinja nguva imwe neimwe rimwe rabviswa. Rekutanga i 6/10, asi kana bhora jena rabuda, rinotevera rinodzika kuita 5/9, saka haigone kuva 0.6 nguva imwe neimwe. Saka miedzo haizvimiriri uye fomula ye binomial inobuda yakakura kupfuura mutengo chaiwo.
y-m-64-09.s.s3.model.1: Sezvo mabhora asingadzorerwi, makeup yemabhora asara inochinja, saka mukana wekubudirira haugari wakagadzikana. Kana mabhora machena achibuda nenhevedzano, mabhora machena asara anodzikira, saka mukana wekuti ese 5 i machena i mudiki kupfuura 0.6 kune 5th power.

y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Mean ne standard deviation yekirasi iyi i 70 ne 10 kuMath, uye 60 ne anenge 5 kuEnglish. Shamwari inofungidzira kuti 'mutests dzese mbiri mamakisi akapararira nechimiro chebhero kutenderedza mean' (izvi hazvisati zvasimbiswa).
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ikozvino tinogona kutaura kuti anoita zvirinani pachidzidzo chipi?
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Mitengo ye standardized i (85 - 70) ÷ 10 = 1.5 kuMath uye (72 - 60) ÷ 5 = 2.4 kuEnglish. Pakuti ari ma standard deviations mangani kubva pamean, English i panzvimbo yakakwira. Zvisinei, kududzira uku kunotsamira pafungidziro isati yasimbiswa yekuti kugoverwa kwemamakisi kune chimiro chebhero.
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Math: i mapoinzi 15 pamusoro pemean, iri mberi kwemapoinzi 12 eEnglish
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakaenzanisa misiyano yemamakisi chete. Tests mbiri dzine kupararira kwemamakisi kwakasiyana, saka mapoinzi 15 nemapoinzi 12 zvakafanana zvinoreva zvakasiyana.
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.1.o.b: English: i 2.4 standard deviations pamusoro, uye Math i 1.5 pamusoro
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Uku i kutonga kwakaenzanisa kuti ari kure zvakadini kubva pamean semultiple ye standard deviation, ne (72 - 60) ÷ 5 = 2.4 ne (85 - 70) ÷ 10 = 1.5.
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Yakafanana: zvidzidzo zvese mbiri mamakisi ari pamusoro pemean
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakatarisa chete chokwadi chekuti ari pamusoro pemean. Hauna kuenzanisa kuti ari pamusoro zvakadini.
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Zvinoratidzika kuti English, asi shoko rechimiro chebhero i fungidziro, saka i yenguva pfupi
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Uku i kutonga kwakaenzanisa nemitengo ye standardized asi kwakafungawo kuti fungidziro yechimiro chekugoverwa haisati yasimbiswa.
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.2.info: Data rekurongeka kwekirasi rinoratidzwa. MuEnglish, 3 pa 30 vakawana 72 kana kupfuura, uye muMath, 2 pa 30 vakawana 85 kana kupfuura. Mamakisi mazhinji eEnglish akaungana pakati pe 55 ne 65, uye vashoma chete vakawana mamakisi akakwirira, saka chimiro chinotambanuka chakareba kurudyi.
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Dai raiva nechimiro chebhero (normal distribution), chikamu che 2.4 standard deviations kana kupfuura pamusoro pemean i anenge 0.8%, saka paifanira kuva anenge 0.25 pavadzidzi 30, asi English ine 3, saka zvakaoma kuitora se normal distribution. KuMath, chikamu che 1.5 kana kupfuura i anenge 6.7%, saka anenge 2 pa 30, izvo zvinoenderana ne 2 chaiwo. Nekurongeka, 72 yeEnglish i mu top 3 pa 30 (10%) uye 85 yeMath i mu top 2 (anenge 6.7%), saka Math i panzvimbo yakakwira zvishoma. Musiyano i mudiki, saka zvinogoneka kutaura kuti 'akafanana', asi mhedziso yekuenzanisa kwe standardized yekuti English i yakakwira zvakanyanya hairienderani nedata rekurongeka.

y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Uku i kutonga kwakaenzanisa nzvimbo zvakananga nedata rekurongeka ra 2 kana kupfuura pa 30 vadzidzi.

y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kududzira mitengo ye standardized kunotsamira pafungidziro yechimiro chebhero. Data rekurongeka rinoratidza kuti fungidziro iyi haienderani neEnglish.
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kuenzanisa kwe standardized kweEnglish kwakaoma kuvimba: kugoverwa kwakarerekera uye hakumiriri nzvimbo zvakanaka

y-m-64-03.title: Kuti upindure 'Tinogona kusarudza vanhu 3 pavanhu 7 nenzira dzingani?', chii chimwe chinodikanwa?

y-m-64-03.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwokutsanangura nemashoko musiyano pakati penyaya apo nhevedzano inokosha neapo isingakoshi kana uchisarudza dzimwe kubva pazvinhu zvakasiyana
y-m-64-03.prereq.2: Ruzivo rwokunyora nokusimbisa kuti pane nzira 6 dzokumisa vanhu 3 mumutsetse
y-m-64-03.s.s1.prompt: Mhinduro inogona kusarudzwa kuva imwe kubva pamubvunzo uyu oga here? Sarudza kutonga kunokodzera zvikuru.
y-m-64-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora mumutsetse mumwe mumwe kuti 35, 210, ne 343 imwe neimwe inoverenga mamiriro api.
y-m-64-03.s.s1.hint.1: Cherechedza kuti kukosha kwega kwega kunobva pamutsara upi womubvunzo. Tarisa kana kukosha kupi kunoshandisa mamiriro asiri mumubvunzo.

y-m-64-03.s.s1.r.a: Izvi zvinoverenga mapoka evanhu 3 vakasiyana chete. Wakatarisa here kuti kunyange kuvanhu vamwe chete 3, kana mabasa avanotora akasiyana, huwandu hwenzira hunowedzera?
y-m-64-03.s.s1.o.b: Kana tisingazivi kuti vanhu 3 vakasarudzwa vachashandiswa sei, haisarudzwi kuva imwe
y-m-64-03.s.s1.r.b: Uku kutonga kwakawana pane mhinduro ingachinja uye kwakakumbira ruzivo.
y-m-64-03.s.s1.o.c: Ndivanhu 3 vachirongwa, saka inosarudzwa se nzira 210
y-m-64-03.s.s1.r.c: Mubvunzo hauna mashoko pamusoro pokurongwa kana pamusoro pokugovera zvinzvimbo. Wakawana kupi mamiriro okuti nhevedzano inokosha?
y-m-64-03.s.s1.o.d: Munhu mumwe anogona kusarudzwa kakawanda, saka inosarudzwa se nzira 343
y-m-64-03.s.s1.r.d: Mamiriro okuti munhu mumwe chete anogona kusarudzwa kakawanda haasi mumubvunzoyo. Iyi ipfungwa zvakare.
y-m-64-03.s.s1.o.e: Mubvunzo hauzivikanwi saka hatigoni kutaura kukosha kupi, uye zvakaoma kunyange kutumidza vasarudzwa
y-m-64-03.s.s1.r.e: Kunyange kana ruzivo rusina kukwana, unogona kurongedza kukosha kunogoneka (35, 210, 343, nezvimwewo, zvichienderana namamiriro). 'Hatigoni kutaura chinhu' kurega zvakanyanya.
y-m-64-03.s.s1.explain: Mubvunzo hauzi kana vanhu 3 vakasarudzwa vanopiwa mabasa akasiyana (kana nhevedzano inokosha) kana kuti munhu mumwe anogona kutora mabasa akati wandei, saka mhinduro haisarudzwi kuva imwe. Zvisinei, kuverenga 'nzira dzokusarudza' sebhoka revanhu 3 vasingaparadzaniswi kunonzwisisika, saka zvakanakawo kupindura nzira 35 uchitaura pfungwa iyoyo.
y-m-64-03.s.s1.acc.0: Kana tikaverenga 'nzira dzokusarudza' sebhoka revanhu 3 vasingaparadzaniswi, ndi nzira 35. Zvisinei, unofanira kutaura pfungwa yokuti zvaizochinja kana paine mamiriro okugovera zvinzvimbo.

y-m-64-03.s.s2.hint.1: Kana yasarudzwa, verenga iwe pachako kukosha munyaya iyoyo. Kana kuverenga kusingabudi sekumwe, ruzivo rushaya.
y-m-64-03.s.s2.o.a: Vanhu 3 vakasarudzwa vanotora zvinzvimbo zvomutungamiri, mutevedzeri, nomunyori, mumwe mumwe, pasina munhu anobata zvinzvimbo zviviri
y-m-64-03.s.s2.r.a: Iyi isarudzo yakaverenga kuti mamiriro anocherekedza kunyange kuti ndiani ane chinzvimbo chipi, saka vanhu vamwe chete 3 vanoverengwa sevakaparadzaniswa munyaya dzakati wandei.

y-m-64-03.s.s2.r.b: Iyi isarudzo yakaverenga kuti mamiriro anoda kucherekedza kuti vanhu 3 ndivanaani chete.
y-m-64-03.s.s2.o.c: Pakati pevanhu 3 vakasarudzwa, pane mudzidzi mumwe kana kupfuura wegore 3
y-m-64-03.s.s2.r.c: Kana tisingazivi kuti makirasi akaumbwa sei, hatigoni kusarudza kuti pane nzira dzingani. Ruzivo urwu harusarudzi kana mabasa akaparadzaniswa kana kuti kubata mabasa maviri kunobvumirwa.
y-m-64-03.s.s2.o.d: Sarudza mutungamiri, mutevedzeri, nomunyori, uye munhu mumwe anogona kubata zvinzvimbo zvakati wandei
y-m-64-03.s.s2.r.d: Iyi isarudzo yakaverenga kuti mamiriro okusarudza mumwe pavanhu 7 pachinzvimbo chega chega akasarudzwa.
y-m-64-03.s.s2.o.e: Mutungamiri atosarudzwa, uye tinosarudza vanhu vezvinzvimbo zvasara
y-m-64-03.s.s2.r.e: Hatigoni kuziva kuti zvinzvimbo zvingani zvasara kana kuti zvinzvimbo zvakasiyana here, saka hazvisati zvasarudzwa kuva kumwe.

y-m-64-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakabatanidza here huwandu hwenzira dzokugovera mabasa kuvanhu vamwe chete 3 nereshiyo (kangani) pakati pekukosha kuviri?
y-m-64-03.s.s3.model.0: 35 inoverenga chete kuti vanhu 3 ndivanaani, uye 210 inoverengawo nyaya dzokugovera zvinzvimbo zvakasiyana kuvanhu 3 vacho. Kunyange kuvanhu vamwe chete 3, pane nzira 6 dzokugovera zvinzvimbo, saka 35×6 = 210.
y-m-64-03.s.s3.model.1: Kana pasina kuparadzanisa zvinzvimbo, ndi nzira 35, uye kana pane zvinzvimbo, nzira 6 dzokurongedza vanhu vamwe chete vatatu dzinowedzerwa kune imwe neimwe, zvichipa nzira 210. Saka unofanira kutanga wabvunza kana mubvunzo une zvinzvimbo.

y-m-64-01.title: Kuongorora kuverenga kwaMinseo kwemataga enhamba
y-m-64-01.topic: Kuverenga nyaya: kuverenga zvinhu zvinoita mamiriro maviri kana kupfuura
y-m-64-01.goal: Wana uye ugadzirise mutsara wakaenda zvisirizvo mukugadzirisa kwakaverenga zvinhu zvinoita imwe kana kupfuura yemamiriro maviri, uye utonge kuti ungabata sei zvakarurama kupindirana kana mamiriro achiwedzera kuita matatu.
y-m-64-01.material: Pachikoro, mabhokisi ekuchengeta anonumberwa kubva pa1 kusvika pa40, nhamba imwe imwe, uye nhamba dzose dzakasiyana. Zvekutarisa vhiki ino "mabhokisi ane nhamba imultiple ye2 kana imultiple ye5." Bhokisi rinoita imwe kana kupfuura yemamiriro maviri rinotarisirwa, uye kunyange kana richiita zvose, rinoverengwa se1. y-m-64-01.s.s2.model.0: Pane zvinangwa 24. Kana ukawedzera mamultiples e2 20 nemamultiples e5 8, 10, 20, 30, 40 dzinopinda kaviri, saka unofanira kubvisa idzo 4 kamwe imwe neimwe. 20 + 8 - 4 = 24.

y-m-64-07.title: Hukama pakati pezviitiko zviviri, sezvinoonekwa kubva pamamiriro ekuva nhengo dze clubs mbiri
